quest.4565D4B2F9FD2553.quest_desc: Most mods don't kill bosses in 1 hit, except Industrial Foregoing's &#B39DDBMob Crusher&r.

quest.4C59B30D38E10434.quest_desc: The best tier of materials, &#FF8C42mystic&r, now we can get even &#FFE169higher effects&r on our gear + the possibility of having &#A8E6CF4 gems&r at the same time.

quest.7B25CDB43EF20BEA.title: &#FFB347Haven&r
quest.7E47E81705E0D3D2.quest_desc: These gateways have been given a new craft, using materials from other &#D1A3D9Apotheosis mods&r, as well as some corruption from &8The Warden&r.
